response: The surgical treatment of prosthetic valve endocarditis (PVE) in patients with double prostheses can be safely managed with single-valve replacement. Transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) plays a crucial role in diagnosing the site of involvement, which correlates with the anatomic diagnosis obtained during the operation. This information helps guide the surgical intervention, making echo-oriented single-valve replacement a viable strategy for patients with PVE and double prostheses. Therefore, single-valve replacement can be considered a safe approach for these patients.
